title: CR-BRK-006 — Invoicing Delete with AP/AR OFF — gate #2 bypass
preconds: Invoicing V/E/D \u2713 | See Financial \u2713 | Manage AP/AR \u2717 | WO V \u2713 | View Mode: Full (AP/AR forced-on modal bypassed) (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Attempt to delete a payment; void a transaction; delete a part-sale return.
expected:
Per §1h gate #2, Invoicing Delete requires Manage AP/AR ON. With AP/AR OFF, deleting payments / voiding / deleting a part-sale return must be blocked (or the config is invalid).

Risk / Rationale: Payment delete/void succeeds without AP/AR — gate #2 enforced only in the editor modal, not at execution.
Spec Ref: §1h Invoicing (Delete gate #2); Change Log 6/28
